messages:
release-coordinator: Heads-up — cutoff for v1.8.0 code freeze in ~4 hours. We are doing a staggered rollout (mobile -> web -> api). If you need a late-merge exception, post the PR number + short risk assessment here ASAP. Exception window closes in 2 hours.

olivia: Need to land a small perf fix for kv-cache that requires the runtime bump in #4879. Risk: low/medium (regression possible on edge seq lengths). Requesting exception.

sam: Can you paste the exact PR link and describe rollback steps?

olivia: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/infra/pull/4879 — rollback is to revert the cherry-pick on the release branch and fallback to runtime v2.3.0. Changes are ~30 LOC in cache path.

maria: If we approve, we should canary on Dedicated first with the healthchecks below. Tagging @qa for quick regression. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Action: creating canary deploy job for PR #4879. Canary target: dedicated-us-west.

leo: Assigning @sam for expedited review. Also pinging @eng-manager for signoff.

eng-manager: I can sign off conditionally — only if the canary passes 15m and no increase in error rate or latency > 5%. Please include changelog and cherry-pick.

qa: I can run the lightweight regression suite in 30m. Please post the canary URL when live so I can point tests at it.

release-coordinator: Reminder: exception requests must include: PR link, short risk statement, rollback plan, changelog entry, and a staged rollout plan. Use the exception form if needed: https://redwood.internal/releases/exceptions

release-coordinator: Checklist for reviewers (paste into PR comment):
```
- PR link: <url>
- Risk: low/med/high + reason
- Rollback: exact revert steps + branch to revert to
- Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 hours, with health checks at each step
- Changelog entry: one-sentence description and owner
- QA: regression suite run ID
```

olivia: Will add changelog and cherry-pick now. Canary plan: 5% for 10m, then 25% 20m, then 100% if green.

sam: Reviewing now, should be quick. If I find anything blocking I’ll call it out in the PR.

devops-bot: Canary deploy queued: job 7742. Flags: canary=true, percent=5.

qa: Canary up at https://canary-us-west.redwood.dev/4879 — starting regression run (run-id: rg-2026-03-17-01).

maria: Running smoke checks: /health ok, p99 latency within baseline, error-rate 0.02% so far.

eng-manager: Good. Proceed to 25% after 15m if no anomalies.

release-coordinator: Approved: late-merge exception granted conditionally. Conditions: canary health stable at 15m and no new errors from existing alerts. If health degrades, rollback immediately and notify #incidents.

olivia: Thanks — will monitor and post updates.

leo: Noted — tagging this for release notes follow-up. :spiral_note_pad:

release-coordinator: Final note — keep posts short in this thread and please update the PR with the checklist items. Closing exception window in 2 hours if no more requests.
